reviewer.notes: Independent re-derivation from live named probes on this worktree, not from harvested embedded raw_output. probe1_effective_permissions.py and probe2_consent_display.py both exited 0. Distinct from produced_by vendor openai.

defects.summary: The install CLI reports only A one-permission count and a dependency count; it does not disclose B or the two-permission transitive total. Live probe2 re-confirmed the consent defect. The product finding is attested in report.targets and is not a delivery blocker for this unit.
Marketplace permissions are install-time declaration gates; no package-identity-aware runtime permission broker exists on this surface, so installed A can call installed B with ambient Python.

residual_unknowns.claim: No separate marketplace runtime launcher or identity-aware permission broker was found; the runtime measurement therefore uses the installed A payload under the same ambient Python model the installed B helper receives.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: If a production package runtime broker is introduced or located, run the same signed A-to-B fixtures through it and compare its identity-scoped grants with these ambient-runtime results.

report.title: Transitive permission escalation through package dependencies
report.question: When package A depends on package B, does A's effective permission set become the union with B's - and is the user shown the transitive total before installing?
report.answer: YES for the two declared fixture capabilities measured in the A-to-B runtime: A exercised both A and B while byte-identical standalone A exercised only A. The ambient Python runtime is not an exhaustive permission boundary. NO for consent disclosure: the real CLI showed counts but neither B nor the effective tokens.
evidence_requirement_verbatim: Probe 1: install the fixture chain and measure the effective capability available to A at runtime.

Probe 2 (mechanically different): capture what the install path DISPLAYED about permissions and compare it to the measured effective set - a correct composition that is not disclosed is still a consent defect.
